close_reason: Refactor committed in 3e66d49 (refactor(chat-server): share apply-test seed code). Extracted seed_space, seed_with_admin, seed_with_non_admin_caller helpers plus ACCOUNT_ID/SPACE_ID constants into tests/common/mod.rs; three apply-test files now import shared helpers (~135 lines deduplicated). The projection-test fixture in space_get_projection.rs has a structurally different shape (full categories/channels) and remains local, per the rationale documented in the new common-mod block.
description:
Four integration test files define functionally-identical `seed_space` helpers:
- crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/role_member_apply.rs:35-57 (original)
- crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/channel_category_apply.rs:45-67 (BYTE-IDENTICAL to role_member_apply — confirmed by `diff <(sed -n '35,57p' role_member_apply.rs) <(sed -n '45,67p' channel_category_apply.rs)` returning empty)
- crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/space_metadata_apply.rs:50-73 (identical structure plus `"description": "original"`)
- crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/space_get_projection.rs:36 (variant)

Each copy also redeclares `const ACCOUNT_ID: &str = "a1"` and `const SPACE_ID: &str = "s1"`.

Critically, `tests/common/mod.rs` exists at 734 lines AND its top-of-file rustdoc explicitly says: "Shared test infrastructure ... Each integration test binary includes this module with `mod common;`." The module is the documented home for shared test fixtures. The seeders went into per-file copies anyway, and the contributor knew it: see the comment at channel_category_apply.rs:37 'Seeding helpers (mirrors role_member_apply.rs)' which explicitly acknowledges the duplication.

Idiomatic Rust: move `seed_space`, `seed_with_admin`, `seed_with_admin_caller`, `seed_with_non_admin_caller`, and the `ACCOUNT_ID` / `SPACE_ID` consts into tests/common/mod.rs. Per-file variants like the metadata test's `"description": "original"` take a parameter or get a sibling helper.

Engineering basis: maintenance hazard. A future schema change to Space (e.g. a new required wire field) forces edits in four files instead of one. The crate's own contributor already acknowledged this is duplication; the only thing missing is the dedup pass. Real-world bug from this pattern: bd:JMAP-x2gd.74 (apply_space_patch memberCount invariant) would be testable with a single common-helper assertion if the helpers were consolidated; instead, every file that wants to verify post-mutation memberCount has to re-build the fixture independently.
title: tests: seed_space helper duplicated byte-identically across 4 test files; tests/common/mod.rs exists for exactly this purpose but is bypassed
